events.title: Dia de los Muertos - La Experiencia
events.description: A free, family-friendly immersive plaza experience with artful Catrinas, colorful skeletons, altars and marigolds, enhanced by new after-sunset lighting, running daily through November 2.

events.title: Reopening After Private Event
events.description: Fiesta de Reyes reopens to the public at 10:00 AM after being closed on October 7 for a private event.

events.title: Mariachi Divinas Live
events.description: Free live Mariachi Divinas performance on the Fiesta de Reyes stage (recurring Wednesdays and Thursdays).

events.title: Los Trinos Mariachi Fusion & Luis Max and Blue Moon Live
events.description: Free Saturday live entertainment with Los Trinos Mariachi Fusion (12:15 pm) followed by Luis Max & Blue Moon (5:00 pm) on the Fiesta de Reyes stage.

events.title: Folklorico Dancing & Los Trinos Mariachi Fusion Live
events.description: Free Sunday entertainment featuring folklorico dancing (11:30 am) and Los Trinos Mariachi Fusion (4:00 pm) on the Fiesta de Reyes stage.

events.title: Dia de los Muertos Celebration
events.description: Casa Guadalajara (with Bazaar del Mundo) honors departed loved ones with decorated altars, free sugar-skull/face-painting activities, and mariachi performances in skeleton face paint.

events.title: Dia de los Muertos Celebration
events.description: Second day of the Day of the Dead festivities at Casa Guadalajara and Bazaar del Mundo, including an Old Town Altar Walk with maps to view decorated altars throughout the neighborhood.

events.title: Dia de los Muertos Procession
events.description: A candlelit procession beginning at Cafe Coyote featuring blessings and Danza Azteca Atlachinolli dances to honor the Day of the Dead.

events.title: La Experiencia - Dia de los Muertos at Barra Barra
events.description: During Fiesta de Reyes' Dia de los Muertos 'La Experiencia' celebration (running through November 2, 2026), the plaza fills with Catrinas, marigolds, altars and glowing displays while Barra Barra serves candlelit house margaritas, tequila flights and dinner.

events.title: Thanksgiving Buffet
events.description: The Cosmopolitan Hotel & Restaurant hosts a traditional Thanksgiving holiday buffet in its historic Old Town setting.

events.title: Altar Tour
events.description: Specialized guided tour through park museums exploring the symbolism of Dia de los Muertos altars and the stories of families who lived in Old Town in the 1800s.

events.description: Annual three-day Day of the Dead celebration (Oct 31 - Nov 2, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily) featuring community and historic altars, live entertainment, hands-on art, and cultural programming.

events.title: La Catrina Contest (Children)
events.description: Children's Catrina costume competition at Plaza de Armas with music, dancing, and prizes for winners.

events.title: La Catrina Contest (Adults)
events.description: Adults' Catrina costume competition at Plaza de Armas with music, dancing, and prizes for winners.

events.title: Candlelit Procession
events.description: Annual candlelit procession from Twiggs Street to El Campo Santo Cemetery featuring Aztec dancers, park staff in 1800s period attire, and Catrina Contest winners.

events.title: Summer Movies in the Park: Practical Magic
events.description: A free outdoor screening of the romantic fantasy film Practical Magic (PG-13), with pre-show activities at 5:30 PM and the movie starting about 15 minutes after sunset.
